text: There's no reason to bring my looks into this. Good day, Leonard. I said Good Day!

text: Also today we have a fresh caught Alaska salmon, and that's served with a teriyaki glaze and sticky rice. Our soup of the day...

text: Why don't you take a minute to decide I can't keep your secret Penny. I'm going to fold like an energy based anobo protein in conformational space. Like a renaissance triptych. Like a cheap suit.

text: Oh, look, why is it so hard for you to keep one little secret?

text: I'm constitutionally incapable. That's why I was refused clearance for a very prestigious government research fellowship at a secret military supercollider, located beneath a fake agricultural station 12.5 miles south east of Travers City, Michigan.
